abstract: Deploy vLLM behind the llm-d router on Kubernetes with Gateway API Inference Extension. Covers the optimized-baseline guide (standalone and gateway router, single-host vLLM, monitoring, calibration, flow control), prefill/decode disaggregation with NIXL, KEDA autoscaling on endpoint-picker metrics, the deprecated WVA, version pins, troubleshooting and verification gaps. References are split into install, P/D, autoscaling and troubleshooting.
